name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen flooring installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen flooring installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the installation crew arrives, homeowners should clear all small items, trash cans, pet dishes, and movable furniture from the kitchen and adjoining entryways. Empty the lower cabinets if the subfloor requires heavy nailing or leveling, as vibrations can rattle dishes. Ensure clear walking pathways from the exterior entry to the kitchen so crew members can move materials safely. If your remodel involves keeping existing appliances, clarify in advance whether your contractor or an appliance specialist is handling gas and water line disconnects for refrigerators and stoves.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out movable items, empty lower cabinets if heavy demolition or leveling is needed, and confirm who is disconnecting appliances before the crew arrives.
